name: CSE Claw
description: Disabled-by-default passive bridge from OpenClaw turns to a local CSE cognition backend.

enabled.label: Enable CSE Claw
enabled.help: Opt in to sending redacted turn summaries to the configured local CSE backend. The bridge is advisory only.

endpoint.label: CSE Backend Endpoint
endpoint.help: HTTP(S) base URL for the local CSE service. Defaults to loopback.

timeoutMs.label: CSE Backend Timeout
timeoutMs.help: Milliseconds to wait before failing open without advisory context.

maxPromptChars.label: Max Prompt Characters
maxPromptChars.help: Maximum redacted user prompt characters sent to CSE before truncation.

maxAssistantChars.label: Max Assistant Characters
maxAssistantChars.help: Maximum redacted assistant/output characters sent to CSE before truncation.

injectAdvisoryContext.label: Inject Advisory Context
injectAdvisoryContext.help: When disabled, CSE pre-turn calls still run for observation but advisory context is not injected into the model prompt.

sharedContextMode.label: Shared Context Mode
sharedContextMode.help: Controls CSE behavior for group/channel contexts. Default audit_only records turns without injecting CSE advisory context.

logFailures.label: Log CSE Bridge Failures
logFailures.help: Logs skipped CSE calls at warn level while preserving fail-open runtime behavior.
